_comment: Test sentences for mixed Greek/English and pharmacy vocabulary. 'parts' are spoken in order by the Greek (el) or English (en) voice; brand names are written the way a Greek pharmacist says them, 'terms' are the spellings expected in the transcript. No real patient data.
